cheapEat.name: Pierogi at Bar Pierożek
cheapEat.note: Bar Pierożek, ul. Sądowa 7; Wikivoyage gives no price for it.

WRO.saveTip: Setka is open 24/7 and sells a glass of beer for 4 zł, about €0.91, according to Wikivoyage.

cheapEat.name: Polish food at Dramat
cheapEat.note: Cheap Polish food on the Rynek; Wikivoyage gives €2-5, low end used.

POZ.saveTip: Avanti serves cheap spaghetti and lasagne fast, and Bar Pod Arkadami is a milk bar for a cheap meal.

cheapEat.name: Currywurst
cheapEat.note: A staple in Berlin; Wikivoyage gives around €3 (April 2022).

BER.saveTip: Kiosks sell bottled beer, and the 8 to 25 cent Pfand deposit on each bottle is refundable.

cheapEat.name: Fischbrötchen from St. Pauli Fischmarkt
cheapEat.note: Best early on Sundays, 05:00-09:30; Wikivoyage gives no price.

HAM.saveTip: Feldstern pub has a weekday lunch menu from 12:00 to 16:00, and its German food is affordable.

cheapEat.name: Leberkässemmel from a butcher
cheapEat.note: Meat loaf in a roll; Wikivoyage gives no price.

MUC.saveTip: Buy Leberkässemmel at a butcher rather than a bakery, which Wikivoyage calls filling and inexpensive.

cheapEat.name: Currywurst with fries
cheapEat.note: Curry B., around Neumarkt; Wikivoyage gives no price for it.

CGN.saveTip: Altstadt pubs usually cost more than those on Zülpicher Straße, according to Wikivoyage.

cheapEat.name: Currywurst at Best Worscht in Town
cheapEat.note: Curry sausage stands with no seating; Wikivoyage gives no price.

FRA.saveTip: Buy drinks at a Trinkhalle, a small shop that is usually open late and sells from the street.

cheapEat.name: Döner kebab
cheapEat.note: Not a local dish; Wikivoyage says a typical döner is around €5-6 with a large drink.

DRS.saveTip: Hebeda's and Ost-Pol in Neustadt are pubs where Wikivoyage says the beer is cheap.

cheapEat.name: Saxon mains at Zills Tunnel
cheapEat.note: Large portions; Wikivoyage gives €9-13 for mains, low end used.

LEJ.saveTip: Sternburg Export costs about 50 cents a bottle in most supermarkets, according to Wikivoyage.

cheapEat.name: Six Nürnberger Rostbratwürstl
cheapEat.note: Heilig-Geist-Spital, over the Pegnitz; Wikivoyage gives €6.70 for six.

NUE.saveTip: Look for Lebkuchen packs labelled 'Bruch', which sell for less because they are unsuitable for souvenir packaging.
